title: Submodules of finite modules over Noetherian rings are finitely presented
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $F$ be a finitely generated $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], and let $G\subseteq F$ be any $R$-submodule. Then $G$ is finitely generated and finitely presented as an $R$-module [def-sc-finitely-presented-module].
